products.name: Haier 7 kg top-load washing machine with Ultra Fresh Air, Brown Grey
products.shortName: 7 kg Ultra Fresh Air top-load washer, Brown Grey
products.summary: Lift the glass lid to see the pillow drum and the blue pulsator, read the front control panel, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: Body only, 90.5 cm tall at the back; with the lid open it is about 125 cm
specs: Ultra Fresh Air, NZP (Near Zero Pressure), Oceanus Wave pulsator, Quick wash
Smart, Soak, Delicate, Quick, with Wash, Rinse, Spin and Tub Dry steps
Front control panel: Water Level, Program, Start/Pause, Power; Child Lock, Auto Restart
Toughened glass, black with Haier logo, soft fall
PCM, Brown Grey; black control panel
2 years comprehensive, 10 years on the motor

hotspots.title: Ultra Fresh Air
hotspots.text: Fresh laundry after every wash: Ultra Fresh Air helps remove odour and moisture, for hygienic, anti-bacteria freshness.

hotspots.title: NZP, Near Zero Pressure
hotspots.text: The wash doesn't stop when water pressure is low: Haier's Near Zero Pressure technology works down to 0.01 MPa, for flats with low water pressure or a low storage tank.

hotspots.title: Pillow Drum
hotspots.text: Pillow-shaped bulges scrub gently, and the 2.2 mm holes between them push clothes softly, reducing wear, tear and abrasion on delicate fabrics.

hotspots.title: Bionic filter
hotspots.text: Two Magic filters with Haier's "Venous valve" design collect lint, so it doesn't jam the machine and your clothes stay clean.

fit.note: From Haier's user manual for the 306 series: keep at least 20 mm between the machine and the wall. The lid swings up and back: with it open the machine is about 125 cm tall (the opening angle is estimated from Haier's photos).
